gloss: last fiscal year; last school year

definitions.gloss: last fiscal year; last school year
definitions.explanation: The fiscal or academic year before the current one. In Japan both usually run from April to March, so {昨年度|さくねんど} is not the same as {昨年|さくねん} (last calendar year).

examples.japanese: {昨年度|さくねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: We look at last fiscal year's sales.

examples.japanese: {昨年度|さくねんど}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The budget increased over last fiscal year.

examples.japanese: {昨年度|さくねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}→卒業生：15284_sotsugyousei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many of last year's graduates found jobs with local companies.

notes:
A formal word used in business, government and school documents. In everyday speech people often just say ⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昨年度|さくねんど}⟦{比|ひ}→比：30310_hi⟧: compared with last fiscal year
- {昨年度|さくねんど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧: last fiscal year's results
- {昨年度|さくねんど}{末|まつ}: the end of last fiscal year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧: this fiscal or school year
- ⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧: next fiscal or school year
- ⟦{昨年|さくねん}→昨年：10433_sakunen⟧: last year — the calendar year, formal
